auth_oauth_transactions_reauth_valid.name: auth_oauth_transactions_reauth_valid
auth_oauth_transactions_reauth_valid.value: "auth_oauth_transactions"."intent" != 'reauth' OR ("auth_oauth_transactions"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_oauth_transactions"."session_hash" IS NOT NULL AND length("auth_oauth_transactions"."session_hash") = 64 AND "auth_oauth_transactions"."identity_id" IS NOT NULL)

auth_oauth_signup_valid.name: auth_oauth_signup_valid
auth_oauth_signup_valid.value: ("auth_oauth_transactions"."signup_policy_version" IS NULL AND "auth_oauth_transactions"."signup_confirmed_at" IS NULL) OR ("auth_oauth_transactions"."provider" = 'google' AND "auth_oauth_transactions"."intent" = 'login' AND typeof("auth_oauth_transactions"."signup_confirmed_at") = 'integer' AND "auth_oauth_transactions"."signup_confirmed_at" = "auth_oauth_transactions"."created_at" AND length("auth_oauth_transactions"."signup_policy_version") BETWEEN 1 AND 80)
